PreInvocation.command: if ! jq -e --arg command '~/.config/claudex/config/hooks/UserPromptSubmit.sh' '.. | .command? // empty | select(. == $command)' "$HOME/.gemini/config/hooks.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/files/home/kai/.config/claudex/config/hooks/UserPromptSubmit.sh"; fi
